---
applyTo: 'src/**/*.ts,src/**/*.html,src/**/*.css'
---

# Angular Rules

# Angular MCP

- Use Angular MCP for Angular project discovery and Angular best-practice guidance when available.
- Prefer Angular MCP tools over terminal commands when they provide equivalent Angular workspace information or examples.

- Use standalone components where possible.
- Prefer modern Angular patterns that match the project version.
- Prefer RxJS operators over nested subscriptions.
- Avoid manual subscriptions without cleanup.
- Keep components small and focused.
- Use services for business logic.
- Prefer reactive forms over template-driven forms.
- Follow Angular style guide conventions.
